mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 6 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 6 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 5.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has been below 5.0 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer confidence and housing market recovery, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST have increased for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 110.0, indicating strong manufacturing activity, the S&P 500 tends to experience positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profits expand.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO > 110.0, or the Rank IC for INDPRO > 110.0 is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.0%, or the Rank IC for the condition is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS growth for 6 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a slowing GDP growth rate (GDPC1) below 2.0% annualized, a rising residential investment (RSAFS) signals a potential recovery in the housing sector that boosts consumer confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: slow GDP growth with housing recovery
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where GDPC1 < 2.0% and RSAFS is rising, or the Rank IC for the condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust economic expansion that boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both INDPRO and UNRATE have moved in the expected direction (INDPRO up, UNRATE down) for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.
